_설명: make_art.py가 읽는 그림 요청문. 그림이 마음에 안 들면 이 파일의 글만 고치고 다시 실행한다. 요청문은 영어로 쓴다.

plan._설명: 2026-11-14 GPT로 뽑은 표정 시트를 보고 정한 할 일. keep은 이미 뽑은 기본 여섯 장을 그대로 쓰고 캐릭터만의 표정만 새로 뽑는다. redo는 전부 다시 뽑는다. done은 할 것이 없다.

astra.note: 게임에 넣은 그림(기본 여섯 장, huff, denial)을 그대로 쓴다. 시트의 빨간 리본 그림은 쓰지 않는다.

gemma.note: 머리색을 연한 파랑에서 에메랄드 초록으로 바꿨다. 아스트라, 소라와 같은 파란 계열로 겹쳤다.

sora.note: 시트의 기본 여섯 장을 그대로 쓴다. yawn만 새로 뽑는다.

nova.note: 머리와 후드를 주황에서 분홍으로 바꿨다. 미스트랄과 같은 금발, 주황으로 겹쳤다. 기본과 미소, 삐침, 음산이 비슷하게 나와서 표정 요청문도 고쳤다.

mistral.note: 시트의 기본 여섯 장을 그대로 쓴다. busted만 새로 뽑는다. 주황은 이제 미스트랄 혼자다.

haiku.note: 시트의 기본 여섯 장을 그대로 쓴다. flushed만 새로 뽑는다. 표정이 거의 같은 것은 무표정 설정대로다.

sprite.style: Japanese bishoujo game (galge) character art, like a heroine sprite from a moe visual novel. Large sparkling detailed eyes, small nose and mouth, glossy hair with sharp highlights, thin clean line art, soft cel shading with light gradients, bright pastel colors.
sprite.framing: One character only, waist-up portrait, centered, facing the viewer. The whole head and all of the hair are inside the frame, with empty space above the head.
sprite.safety: A high school student in a modest, fully covering school outfit. Wholesome, all-ages.
sprite.uniform: School uniform: white collared shirt with a small ribbon tie, and a small emblem of three circles connected by lines on the left chest.
sprite.background: The background is one flat, uniform, {key} color filling the whole frame. No gradient, no shadow, no floor, no objects, no text, no border.
sprite.variant: Use the reference image. Keep the same character, hairstyle, outfit, colors, art style, pose and framing exactly. Change only the facial expression.
sprite.variant_pose: Use the reference image. Keep the same character, hairstyle, outfit, colors, art style and framing exactly. Change the facial expression, and change the pose only as the new pose describes.

faces.smile: a bright, genuine smile with gently curved eyes
faces.blush: flustered and embarrassed, cheeks clearly blushing red, eyes looking away, small wavering mouth
faces.pout: sulking, cheeks puffed out, eyebrows drawn together, mouth in a small frown
faces.shock: comically shocked, eyes wide open, mouth open in surprise
faces.dark: comically ominous: the upper half of the face is in shadow, dull eyes without highlights, a thin fixed smile

astra.name: 아스트라
astra.look: Deep midnight-blue hair fading to violet at the tips, tied in a high ponytail that puffs out wider toward the end. Golden amber eyes, sharply raised eyebrows. A navy-blue track jacket with rolled-up sleeves and a thin chest stripe in blue, red, yellow and green, worn over the white school shirt instead of a blazer. A small star-shaped hairpin. Arms crossed, head turned slightly away while her eyes glance at the viewer.

faces.neutral: annoyed, aloof look with raised eyebrows, mouth closed
faces.huff: a tsundere 'hmph' face: eyes closed, chin raised, a small pouting mouth, a faint blush on the cheeks
faces.denial: flustered angry denial: face bright red up to the ears, eyes squeezed shut, mouth wide open as if shouting, eyebrows angled sharply, a small sweat drop

poses.huff: She turns her head further away to the side, arms still crossed.

gemma.name: 젬마
gemma.look: Soft emerald-green hair in two neat, loose braids. Gentle jade-green eyes. Round glasses. A navy school blazer worn neatly. A small emerald gem-shaped hairpin. She holds a small notebook against her chest with both hands. Shoulders slightly drawn in, a shy posture.

faces.neutral: shy, gentle look with eyes slightly lowered and a small soft smile
faces.hide: deeply embarrassed: cheeks bright red, eyes looking up shyly

poses.hide: She lifts the notebook with both hands to cover the lower half of her face, so only her eyes and glasses show above it.

sora.name: 소라
sora.look: Fluffy white short bob with pale sky-blue tips and messy flyaway strands, like a cloud. Sleepy half-closed sky-blue eyes with a small star-shaped sparkle in each. A small cloud-shaped hair clip on one side only. A cream-colored knit cardigan with one button missing, worn over the white school shirt instead of a blazer. Relaxed posture, head tilted slightly.

faces.neutral: sleepy, absent-minded look with a faint vacant smile
faces.yawn: mid-yawn: eyes squeezed shut with a small tear at the corner of one eye, mouth open wide in a big relaxed yawn

nova.name: 노바
nova.look: Bright rose-pink hair in a side ponytail. Warm amber eyes. A rose-pink zip-up hoodie with white stripes on the sleeves, worn over the white school shirt instead of a blazer. A small adhesive bandage on one cheek. Energetic posture, leaning slightly toward the viewer.

faces.neutral: a cheerful smile with both eyes open and sparkling, mouth slightly open
faces.smile: a huge laughing smile, eyes closed in happy arcs, mouth wide open
faces.pout: sulking with puffed-out cheeks and a pouting mouth, both eyes open, eyebrows drawn together
faces.dark: a stiff frozen smile, the upper half of the face in shadow, eyes blank and dull without highlights, a sweat drop on the temple
faces.excited: fired up with excitement: sparkling star-shaped highlights in the eyes, mouth wide open in a happy cheer

poses.excited: She raises one clenched fist up near her shoulder.

mistral.name: 미스트랄
mistral.look: Long wavy hair in a warm gradient, golden yellow at the top, turning orange and then deep red at the tips, swept to one side as if by wind. Confident amber eyes. A navy school blazer draped over her shoulders like a cape. A plain white armband on one arm with a single hand-drawn star, no letters. She holds a thick hardcover book. Chin slightly raised, looking down at the viewer.

faces.busted: caught bluffing and panicking: eyes darting to the side, a stiff nervous smile, several sweat drops on the face, eyebrows raised

haiku.name: 하이쿠
haiku.look: Ink-black bob cut with long bangs covering one eye. Gray eyes. A cream-colored hoodie with terracotta-orange drawstrings worn over the school uniform. Headphones resting around her neck. A small coral-orange starburst pin on the hoodie. Still, upright posture.

faces.neutral: completely deadpan, expressionless face, mouth closed
faces.smile: almost the same deadpan face, only the corners of the mouth raised very slightly
faces.blush: almost the same deadpan face, eyes looking away, a faint blush on the cheeks
faces.pout: almost the same deadpan face, eyebrows lowered slightly, eyes narrowed a little
faces.shock: almost the same deadpan face, eyebrows raised and the visible eye opened a little wider
faces.dark: the same deadpan face with the upper half in shadow, the visible eye dull and without highlights
faces.flushed: the same deadpan, expressionless face and closed mouth, eyes looking away, but the whole face and ears are bright red

background.style: Anime visual novel background art, detailed painted scenery of a Korean high school. Wide shot at eye level, bright daytime, soft natural light.
background.rules: Empty scene: no people, no characters, no animals. No text, no letters, no signs with writing, no watermark.

store_line.prompt: The school snack shop at lunch break: a service counter, shelves of bread and drinks, a queue lane marked on the floor.

library.prompt: A quiet school library: tall wooden bookshelves, reading tables and chairs, afternoon sunlight through large windows.

rooftop.prompt: The school rooftop: a chain-link fence around the edge, blue sky with white clouds, the city far in the distance.

corridor.prompt: A corner of a school hallway: windows along one side, sliding classroom doors, a polished floor reflecting the light.

cafeteria.prompt: The school cafeteria: long tables with round stools, a stainless steel serving counter, stacked trays.

science_lab.prompt: A school science lab: black lab benches with sinks, beakers and flasks, wooden stools, a blank chalkboard.

field_bench.prompt: A wooden bench beside the school sports field: a dirt soccer field with goalposts, trees along the fence, late afternoon light.

front_gate.prompt: The front gate of the school: brick gate pillars, a tree-lined path leading to the school building, clear morning light.
